name: ntfy-notify
description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when Claude Code needs your input. The message is generic. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: A private, hard-to-guess ntfy.sh topic. Subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Anyone who knows the name can read your notifications. Empty means no push is sent.
